packageRules.description: Auto-merge lockfile-only dev-dependency patch/minor bumps — tooling only, no app-runtime risk, keeps noise out of manual review.
Batch routine minor/patch bumps into one PR per manager run; majors stay separate for individual review.

OpenTelemetry packages must move in lockstep across every update type, including majors — a prior version mismatch (Temporal's OTel interceptor pinned to 1.x vs the workspace's 2.x) broke instrumentation, so all @opentelemetry/* bumps land in a single PR.
